title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Hardship Program Guidelines
content:
## 1. Who may ask

A borrower facing job loss, medical hardship, a natural disaster or reduced income may ask to defer scheduled payments on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account; the request is the borrower's own and is recorded as a hardship request.

## 2. Seasoning of the account

A deferral is granted only when the account was funded at least the stated number of full calendar months before the request. Calendar months are counted from the funded date, and when the same day does not exist in a month the last day of that month is used.

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | The funded date on the financing account |
| Unit | Full calendar months |
| Month without the same day | The last day of that month is used |
| Request on the date the stated months are reached | Seasoned; the condition is met |
| Request before that date | Not seasoned |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** For an account funded on 2025-08-31 and a seasoning figure of 6 full calendar months, the sixth month ends on 2026-02-28, because February 2026 has no 31st. A request made on 2026-02-28 meets the condition; a request made on 2026-02-27 does not.

## 3. Clauses retired for plans without a promotion

> In addition the plan must offer deferral, the account must be no more than the stated days past due, the months requested may not exceed the plan's maximum per deferral, and the months already used plus those requested must stay within the plan's lifetime maximum.

For a hardship request on an account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), this clause is no longer in force; the conditions such a request must meet, and the months the borrower may ask for, are governed by the current hardship request basis of Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing. A request on an account whose plan carries a promotion remains under this clause.

> A request that fails any condition is declined.

For a hardship request on an account whose plan carries no promotion, this clause is no longer in force; which such requests are declined, and the months granted on the others, are governed by the current hardship deferral decision basis. A request on an account whose plan carries a promotion remains under this clause.

## 4. Effect of a deferral

Deferred payments move to the end of the term; interest keeps accruing and a promotional end date is never extended.

## Questions answered by these guidelines

**Does a deferral stop interest?** No. Interest keeps accruing on deferred payments.

**Does a deferral push back the end of a promotion?** No. A promotional end date is never extended.

**Where do the deferred payments go?** To the end of the term.

superseded_clauses: In addition the plan must offer deferral, the account must be no more than the stated days past due, the months requested may not exceed the plan's maximum per deferral, and the months already used (finance_msr_deferral_months_used) plus those requested must stay within the plan's lifetime maximum.
A request that fails any condition is declined.
